units.source_text: 信辅清楚的记得，当时他这本书只卖了七十钱。

en.t: Shinsuke remembered clearly that at the time he had sold this book for only seventy sen.

units.source_text: 讨价还价半天，好不容易才以一圆四十钱，也就是当时卖价的两倍，最后把书又买了回来。

en.t: After bargaining for a long time, he finally managed to buy the book back for one yen and forty sen, exactly twice what he had sold it for then.

units.source_text: 下雪的的夜晚，不管时候街道两边的住户，还是路上开过的电车，都有种微妙的寂静感。

en.t: On that snowy night, both the houses lining the street and the streetcars passing along the road seemed filled with a subtle stillness.

units.source_text: 他走过街道，回到很远的本所路上，不时记挂着怀里的那本铁灰色封面的《查拉图斯特拉如是说》。

en.t: As he walked through the streets on the long way back to Honjo, he kept thinking now and then of the iron-gray covered copy of Thus Spoke Zarathustra tucked inside his coat.

units.source_text: 与此同时，他嘴里又不由的嘲笑自己……

en.t: At the same time, he could not help mocking himself under his breath again...
